code: OUTDOOR SENSOR OPEN OR SHORT CIRCUIT
meaning: The display window flashes "Err" and the outdoor pointer: the outdoor sensor is either open or short circuit. The control is programmed to assume an outdoor temperature of 32 F (0 C) and control the supply temperature accordingly.
checks: Follow the testing procedure in step four of the installation procedure on page 2 of the brochure.
Check that the settings have been made correctly and that the problem is not a result of external causes.
Make sure that all wiring connections are solid and the sensors are correctly located.

code: SUPPLY SENSOR OPEN OR SHORT CIRCUIT
meaning: The display window flashes "Err" and the supply pointer: the supply sensor is either open or short circuit. The control turns off its relays in order to shut down the heating equipment it is controlling.
checks: Follow the testing procedure in step four of the installation procedure on page 2 of the brochure.
Check that the settings have been made correctly and that the problem is not a result of external causes.
Make sure that all wiring connections are solid and the sensors are correctly located.
